create.name: Arielle Guttman
create.bio:
Arielle Guttman is an astrologer with more than forty years of practice and the founder and director of Sophia Venus, through which she teaches and reads charts. Her early work joined astrology with mythology, archetypes and dreams, and with Kenneth Johnson she wrote the two volumes of Mythic Astrology. She trained in Astro*Carto*Graphy with Jim Lewis in 1986 and went on to develop her own approaches to astro-mapping and geodetic, or earth-based, astrology.

During the 2004 transit of Venus across the Sun she began working on the five-pointed pattern Venus traces over eight years, which became her system of the Venus Star Point, set out in her 2011 book Venus Star Rising. The Venus Star Point is the Sun-Venus conjunction before a person's birth, which she reads as a key to their gifts and what they long for. She now offers Venus Star, natal, progressed, relationship and relocation readings over Zoom, a three-level recorded training with an optional practitioner exam, and recorded webinars. She also leads small group journeys to ancient sites in Greece that join astrology, mythology and dreamwork.

books.title: Venus Star Rising
books.author: Arielle Guttman
books.description: Her book introducing the Venus Star Point, the eight-year star pattern of Venus and how its five points relate to individual charts and to turning points in history, with tables for finding your own point.

books.title: Mythic Astrology Internalizing the Planetary Powers
books.author: Arielle Guttman and Kenneth Johnson
books.description: The first of two volumes written with Kenneth Johnson that read the planets through the myths and gods behind them, as inner forces in a person's life.

books.title: Mythic Astrology Applied
books.author: Arielle Guttman and Kenneth Johnson
books.description: The companion volume with Kenneth Johnson, applying mythic images of the planets to chart interpretation and personal growth.

books.title: The Venus Star Point: Getting It Straight
books.author: Arielle Guttman
books.description: A short e-book clarifying how the Venus Star Point is found and read.

courses.title: Astrology Readings with Arielle
courses.description: One-to-one Zoom readings, including her Venus Star reading, natal, progressed, relationship and relocation charts, booked through a calendar on her site and recorded if wished.

courses.title: Venus Star Point Training Program
courses.description: A recorded professional training in three levels, from the astronomy and geometry of the Venus orbit to chart examples and advanced material on transits and progressions; an exam leads to a practitioner certificate.
courses.price: Level 1, 2 or 3: $150 each; All Three Levels: $400

courses.title: Astro Mapping Seminar
courses.description: A downloadable recording of her seminar on astro-mapping, three videos with handouts, given in Albuquerque in 2015.

courses.title: Summer Solstice Celebration and Saronic Greek Island Tour
courses.description: A June 2027 group journey to Aegina, Poros and Hydra, marking the solstice at ancient temple sites; the page currently takes early interest ahead of booking.

free_resources.title: Find Your Venus Star Point
free_resources.description: A free PDF handout from her site for working out your own Venus Star Point from your date of birth.

free_resources.title: The Venus Mudra Meditation
free_resources.description: A short guided meditation on her YouTube channel using a hand gesture associated with Venus.
